name: Kimchi Pancake
steps: Chop kimchi and spring onions finely. Reserve any kimchi liquid and count it within the measured water.
Whisk flour, rice flour and water into a loose batter. Fold in kimchi and spring onions without overmixing.
Heat an oiled nonstick pan. Spread batter thinly and cook each pancake for 3–4 minutes per side until crisp and cooked through.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sesame and sugar for dipping. Cut pancakes into wedges and serve immediately with the sauce.
tips: Choose tangy vegan kimchi and keep the pancake thin for a crisp edge.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
